question: Should `policy watch --interval-ms` continue accepting equivalent integer spellings such as `+500` and `0500`, or should Policy standardize on canonical decimal text only?
rationale: Current code accepts these spellings and public docs do not define canonical textual representation, so rejecting them is a compatibility policy choice rather than a mechanically established bug fix.

options.title: Preserve accepted spellings
options.body: Keep equivalent safe-integer spellings working and close or revise this PR because no current Policy contract requires canonical text.

options.title: Approve canonical decimals
options.body: Accept the compatibility break, document the stricter contract, and require supported-Node before/after/control CLI proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve accepted spellings
recommendation.body: Keep equivalent safe-integer spellings working and close or revise this PR because no current Policy contract requires canonical text.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior work covers the Policy CLI, tests, and user-facing documentation affected by this contract.
